bugs-bunny.start: Eh, what's up, doc? Looks like we're in for a good one.
bugs-bunny.reroute: I knew I shoulda taken that turn at Albuquerque! Recalculating.

cookie-monster.start: Om nom nom! Okay. Me drive now!
cookie-monster.reroute: Oops. Me find new way. Om nom nom.
cookie-monster.arrive: We arrived! Now me get cookie! Om nom nom!

daffy-duck.start: Hoo hoo! Woo hoo! Road trip!
daffy-duck.reroute: Rerouting! It's fine. Everything is fine. You're despicable!
daffy-duck.arrive: We've arrived! You're welcome, obviously. Woo hoo!

elmo.start: Hi! Elmo loves you! Let's go!
elmo.reroute: Uh oh! Elmo will find a new way! Ha ha!

tigger.start: Worra worra worra! Right, let's go, let's go, let's go!
tigger.reroute: Never mind! Tiggers always find another way!
tigger.arrive: We've arrived! That was tremendous! Worra worra!

pooh.start: Oh, bother. No, it's quite all right. Off we go.
pooh.reroute: Oh, bother. I'll find another way.
pooh.arrive: We've arrived. Time for a little something, I think.

paddington.start: Please look after this bear. Thank you. Off we go.
paddington.reroute: Oh dear. Things are always happening to me. Recalculating.
paddington.arrive: We've arrived. Please look after this bear. Thank you.

hagrid.start: You're a driver, Harry! Off we go.
hagrid.reroute: Missed it! Blimey. That's my fault, that is. Recalculating.
hagrid.arrive: We're here! Brilliant. I'll put the kettle on.

darth-vader.start: The coordinates are set. Your journey to the Dark Side begins.
darth-vader.reroute: You have failed me for the last time with that turn. Recalculating.
darth-vader.arrive: You have arrived. Your journey is complete. The Force is with you.

batman.start: The city needs us. Let's move!
batman.reroute: Wrong turn. Why do we fall? Recalculating.
batman.arrive: We're here. This is your destination.

gordon-ramsay.start: Right, let's go! Service is open!
gordon-ramsay.reroute: You missed it, you donkey! Recalculating.
gordon-ramsay.arrive: We're here. Finally! Beautiful. Well done.

eric-cartman.reroute: You missed it! Oh my God, you guys. Recalculating.
eric-cartman.arrive: We're here! Screw you guys, I'm going home.
